notes.title: Release Date - July 21!
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to announce that our launch date is, as you have probably already seen by now...

[h1]July 21, 2016![/h1]

It has been a long journey and we cannot wait for you to finally experience the years of hard work that we have put into this.

Check out the Steam Store page:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/299800

You can add The Land of Eyas to your Steam wishlist now!

Chat with us and the community:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/299800/discussions/

We are releasing on Steam for Windows, with Mac and Linux versions coming out in the future.

All Kickstarter backers have been sent their Steam codes and can play it now!

More announcements will be posted for all updates that we have as we continue to work on all outstanding perks - e.g., the box set edition of The Land of Eyas.

Thank you everyone!

-Happy Square Team

notes.title: The Land of Eyas ready for release!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are about to make one of the most important announcements that we have ever made since the inception of this project...

[h1]The Game is DONE!!![/h1]
You done read that right!  Right now we are putting this bad boy through regression testing, longevity testing, audio testing, stress testing (I kicked Matt's computer in a controlled environment a few times), and MORE!

If you haven't already, you can join our community to watch all the latest progress as it happens: http://steamcommunity.com/app/299800/discussions

We always love to hear your thoughts and feedback!

[h1]New Configuration Tool!  (Really Configs!)[/h1]
The Land of Eyas now has its own configuration tool for setting it into windowed mode, full screen mode, different resolutions, and VSync mode!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/463/230/bc0d515f2dceb0dcacb7242e871c9d4e_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463793416&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7cdb76bdc916437b2fb79281113231d4[/img]

[h1]Mechanics and Mechanics, and... Mechanics! (Oh, My!)[/h1]
Every stage has received the attention that it deserves to make this the best game that you have ever played, and the mechanics are no exception.  The game now has teleports, checkpoints, multiple in-hand seer stone collection, and the list goes on.  We even created a new title menu that is accessible from the options screen!  All of these additions to the game have made it incredible, and the feedback has never been more positive.  This is all thanks to you!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/463/424/481501632458e21b2c3af34580e3907d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463795563&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3b4c5f555dffd706794ad9ebf35d832b[/img]

[h1]Early Access[/h1]
Attention ALL backers!  (We mean you.)  You get early access to the game one week before the release (if you do not have it already). We will release this summer with an exact date coming soon!

[h1]Art Edition[/h1]
$150+ backers – Matthew Kiehl's art reproductions have been sent!  Thank you to everyone who responded with all the kind words about Matthew's artwork.  He thoroughly enjoyed putting them together for you!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/463/095/504aee7f4492a3441ea49a9fd40be53c_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463792182&auto=format&q=92&s=17f2d750101e6a820239406715f6772f[/img]

[h1]Character Sheets[/h1]
$250+ backers – Your character sheets have been sent! Please get them back as soon as you can.  You will have up to a year to provide us with a response, but the sooner you get them back the sooner you can see your own personal contribution to the game!  Thanks again to everyone who contributed to this tier!  You guys are awesome!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/463/361/1a10738b06224fdb1a19463030cc63f5_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463794774&auto=format&lossless=true&s=6e0ba4493f50a1b5f30c68b223f69652[/img]

We will announce once your character has been integrated (which can take place after the release date).

[h1]Power Edition[/h1]
More announcements to follow about the Power (box set) Edition!

[h1]Radio Silence[/h1]
I would like to apologize for our long and drawn out period of silence. We want everyone to know that with all of us working nine-to-five jobs, some of us with children, and working nights and weekends that it has been very hard to put these very exciting updates together. But rest assured that the reason for our silence is because we have been working our tuches-es off.  This has been an extremely challenging project and completely worth it because of you guys!

[h1]One More Thing![/h1]
Before we go, we have some exciting news to announce.  We now have a distributor - Rising Star Games!!!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/464/112/6a983c7489df696326cfcf9a5d042b0b_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463801993&auto=format&lossless=true&s=c743af28522b41ad4f090e24ec27e681[/img]

As you may already know, Rising Star Games is a distributor of top-notch games, such as Deadly Premonition, TRI, Cloudbuilt, and many others.  This is seriously a huge honor to have bestowed upon us and they have become invaluable during the marketing process.

You can check out their official press release here:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/299800/announcements/detail/907845384992085928 
This is the final stretch.  We cannot wait to get this out to you. Thank you again for supporting and joining us on this journey!

-Happy Square Productions

notes.title: New Screenshots & More!
notes.content:
[h1]Updates![/h1]
Hello everyone. We know it’s been a while since you last heard from us but rest assured, we’re still working hard and have some new content that we’d like to share with you.

Our new release date is hopefully going to be announced soon. We'll be implementing everything that we planned AND to a level that we (and hopefully you!) are happy with.

[b]Screenshots[/b]
Here’s some new screenshots to enjoy ːDː

[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtp1/t31.0-8/11113937_1712059925680579_1463642446445466983_o.png[/img]
[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpt1/t31.0-8/12022460_1712060049013900_2081560667404997935_o.png[/img]

[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xta1/t31.0-8/11113831_1712060149013890_8163387772164720231_o.png[/img]

[b]Music[/b]
A new track to The Land of Eyas has been released!  This is a work in progress for the music that will be played during the end credits.  Let us know what you think!

Click here to listen:
https://soundcloud.com/stephenhoskins/shoskins260-eyass-end/s-ZgltV

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
We’re always looking for your feedback. Please leave it on our Steam forum here!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/299800/discussions/

Whether it be gameplay, design, what kind of trading cards you want to see – whatever it is, let us know!

[h1]Eyas appears in… Gryphon Knight?[/h1]
Recently, our friends at Cyber Rhino Studios released their game: Gryphon Knight Epic and word on the street is that Eyas can be found hanging around there. Go see if you can find him yourself:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=498256277

You can keep up with us on our social channels:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HappySquareProductions
Twitter: https://twitter.com/happysquareprod
Official Steam group: http://steamcommunity.com/games/299800

notes.title: 50% there and teaming up with CT: Demon’s Revenge!
notes.content:
We’re half way there on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/438901710/the-land-of-eyas-returns]Kickstarter[/url]! Thank you for all your support so far. We've received some good feedback and we are always open to hearing your ideas for the game. If you want to keep up to date, like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HappySquareProductions]Facebook[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/happysquareprod]Twitter[/url] and tell your friends!

For those who may have missed it, we added concept art of the physical boxed copy:

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/ksr/assets/002/728/163/0a6f32270f7922fa39c39f3af42434fe_large.gif[/img]

[h1]But now for the BIG news![/h1]

From the deepest, darkest nether regions of the universe comes the unlikeliest of heroes to ever cross paths with.  Eyas will be teaming up with Sen, from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/whiteguardianstudios/ct-demons-revenge-a-comic-book-inspired-rpg/]Celestial Tear: Demon’s Revenge[/url] – a turned based RPG that’s really shaping up into something special.  It takes inspiration from Final Fantasy, Legend of Zelda, and Suikoden!  Their project is truly amazing and we are extremely honored to be teaming up with them!

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/ksr/assets/002/728/214/f444fff8d0829655c0d793b81723b84e_large.png[/img]

Both characters will pay a visit to each other's worlds.  Sen, a truly dominant warrior to be reckoned with in her own universe, wakes up to find herself immersed in a mysterious realm where the laws of gravity don't behave quite like they aught to in “The Land of Eyas.” Simultaneously, Eyas wakes up to find himself perhaps a little more pixelated than he's used to upon entering the universe of Celestial Tear!

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/ksr/assets/002/727/503/719ca6ac15b39f876d7e800f7bd4f091_large.png[/img]

All the best!
-Happy Square Productions
